[EVENT] User is thinking of getting a baby gym or playmat but is unsure which one to choose.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided factors to consider when deciding between a baby gym and a playmat:
- Baby gyms have interactive toys, adjustable height, music and lights, and are good for tummy time.
- Playmats provide a large play area, sensory stimulation, are easy to clean, and are portable.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considering a hybrid option that combines elements of both.
